corrections: Typed SWD/RWDT reset requests select actual C5 CPU/Core/System causes. A dispatched request freezes further watchdog pumping until reboot applies its domains.
Simultaneous SWD/RWDT at228M nominal cycles preserves SWD0x12 across repeated clock refresh, MMIO and advance.
Validated profile selection/exit explicitly invalidates cached IRQ state; asserted RWDT source18 is removed from CLIC input23 after raw-ROM replacement.
Both Machine and Bringup loaders reject replacing a validated ROM while a reset awaits application, before profile/observer/ROM/PC/mode mutation.
RWDT follows actual DIG_REG DCAP128 and LP slow-clock selection; DCAP129 withdraws its source rather than retaining a fallback. Core reset preserves LP controller; System/SWD reset clears it.

negativeHistory.outcome: Initial native integration reached the same TIMG0 boundary but warned that the alternative Bringup loader ignored the new Result. The loader and its regression were corrected; final suite and both Clippy checks have no allowance.

limits: Functional nominal240MHz scheduler, not physical DFS/reset-pulse timing. Cold RWDT prefix has no reconstructed ticks until its actual supported slow-clock input is known.
LP_CLKRST CPU-reset permission remains fixed header POR false; its conflicting TRM polarity is documented and unsupported writes fault.
TIMG0 flashboot watchdog is the next unimplemented actual boundary; no ordinary MWDT execution support is claimed.
No application entry, original LCD framebuffer, buttons, guest TF mount or Wi-Fi acceptance.
Default-LTO full workspace tests, CPU controls, production WASM/browser and fresh final release acceptance remain pending. C5 changes are private; public SRAM-only policy remains.
